title: Capturing the risk of persisting depressive symptoms: A dynamic network investigation of patients' daily symptom experiences
limitations: - Limited number of assessments per participant; - Did not model random slopes due to overfitting; - Used median split for group assignment; - Potential confounding by antidepressant use; - Cannot confirm true dynamic associations due to possible underlying factors.
notes: The study did not explicitly mention preregistration, but code and data were declared available. The network analysis used multilevel VAR models with permutation testing for group differences. The study focused on symptom dynamics over time, not cross-sectional associations.
